pr_title: fix(test runner): account for errors with inconsistent stack/message

issue_context.title: [BUG] Received String 'undefined' is not printed completely
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.14.1
- Operating System: Mac
- Node.js version: 12.22
- Browser: All

<!-- CLI to auto-capture this info -->
<!-- npx envinfo --preset playwright --markdown -->

**Code Snippet**

Help us help you! Put down a short code snippet that illustrates your bug and
that we can run and debug locally. For example:

```javascript
const { test, expect } = require("@playwright/test");

test('basic test', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('https://playwright.dev/');
  const title = page.locator('.navbar__inner .navb1ar__title'); // Intentionally fail the test
  await expect(title).toHaveText('Playwright');
});
```
Output Trace
```
Timeout of 15000ms exceeded.
Pending operations:
      - locator.textContent at node_modules/@playwright/test/lib/test/matchers/matchers.js:195:29
      - 
Error: expect(received).toHaveText(expected)

Expected string: "Buy"
Received string: undefi // not rendered completely
```

**Describe the bug**

If the locator is not found, the Received string doesn't print `undefined` completely
comments: Note: I also encountered this sometimes with various other thrown errors in the past.
